scope: English practice companion bookends and a unified character challenge card

changes.companionMessages: English opening and closing seeds for Oliver, Ruby and Marcus; English fallback for other companions; AI prompt requires concise English.
changes.cache: Language-specific practice.companion.v2.en namespace; responses containing non-ASCII letters are rejected. Old Chinese cache data is preserved but never read as the current contract.
changes.challengeCard: Current level, nine stars, next-star points and challenge action share one container. A book seal, centered title and full-width 开启单元挑战 action mark the unlocked state. Accumulating and active states retain their appropriate progress or continue action.
changes.simplification: Removed separate journey row, repeated character totals in unlocked/active states, status capsule and extra progress captions. Existing actual history rewards remain visible.
changes.interaction: Journey details, direction selection, pending history filter, swipe navigation and saved chat drafts remain available. Existing press feedback respects reduced motion.

swift.coverage: English seeds and length/sentence validation, persona cache reuse and invalidation, Chinese old/current cache rejection, invalid AI output retry and task labels

ui.initialFailure: Existing history test accessed a lazy third row before scrolling it into view after the card became taller. Added scrolling before record assertions; no product change required.
ui.coverage: Normal unified card containment, dark maximum accessibility text and long history titles, pending filter and journey navigation, swipe/draft preservation, and English cover/summary after completing both local reading sections

visualReview.result: Normal card shows the integrated level/star hierarchy and clear primary action. English companion text wraps cleanly on both bookends. Dark maximum-size card and history remain scrollable and readable.
visualReview.computerUse: Device Hub selected the existing simulator, but returned a blank screenshot; inspected XCTest attachments and simctl screenshot instead.

preview.data: Explicitly labeled local sample progress; no account scoring

release.availability: Native UI requires the updated iOS build.
